title: Quarterly cadence: Private/Edge deployment readiness and initiative sprint sequencing
creator: Maya Thompson
description: Goal: Define a repeatable quarterly cadence and sprint sequencing playbook for Private (VPC/on-prem) and Edge deployments tailored to enterprise customers. This ticket captures the plan to align OKRs, scope slices, infra readiness gates, and cross-functional checkpoints so we can consistently ship private deployment capabilities each quarter with predictable risk and capacity planning. Deliverables: 1) a cadence playbook that maps initiative gates to engineering sprints and PM milestones; 2) a risk matrix for common private deployment blockers (KMS/HSM integrations, network topology, upgrade windows, certification); 3) a staged release schedule template (pilot -> tranche -> full roll) with acceptance criteria and rollback thresholds; 4) a cross-team runbook listing required outputs from infra, security, SRE, and solutions engineering for each wave. This playbook will be used to plan Q2 and Q3 private delivery slices and to inform sales/CS timelines for enterprise onboarding.
acceptance_criteria: Cadence playbook reviewed and approved by Infra, Security, SRE, and Solutions Engineering
Template release schedule with pilot/tranche/full rollout and clear metrics for go/no-go
Risk matrix with mitigations and SLAs for highest-impact failure modes
Three example initiative sequences created for common enterprise scenarios (new customer install, in-place upgrade, regional on-prem roll)
At least one customer-facing delivery timeline generated and validated with Customer Success
